europe_now.title: Zelenskyy Addresses Potential Ukraine Security Deal and Territorial Proposals
europe_now.summary: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy stated that a security arrangement could potentially be subjected to a public referendum. Additionally, reports indicate that US negotiators raised the prospect of Ukraine ceding the Donbas region in exchange for NATO membership.

sources.headline: Ukraine: Zelenskyy says security deal could go to referendum
US suggested Ukraine could give up Donbas for NATO membership, Zelenskyy says

europe_now.title: Anti-Government Demonstrations and Security Deployments in France
europe_now.summary: France faced ongoing protests addressing living costs and policing practices, marking a continuation of unrest. Authorities responded by mobilizing significant police forces across the country to manage the demonstrations.

sources.headline: France protests for fifth Saturday against living costs and heavy-handed policing

top_stories.title: Civil Unrest and Domestic Pressures in France
top_stories.summary: Demonstrators took to the streets in France for consecutive weekends to protest economic conditions and security measures. Concurrently, school principals expressed mounting concerns regarding the severity of threats and violence within educational institutions.
